full_name: Ruth Mack | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2013–2014 Humanities Walter Jackson Bate Fellow University at Buffalo
bio: Ruth Mack is an associate professor of English at the University at Buffalo, where she specializes in 18th-century British literature. Her first book, Literary Historicity: Literature and Historical Experience in Eighteenth-Century Britain (Stanford University Press, 2009), examines the philosophy of history that emerged from literature’s questions about how the category of “experience” could contain the past.
